sam: Metrics look stable from infra side. No elevated GPU OOMs or queue backpressure. Nice work.

aj: I'll add a short note to the release notes and link the perf logs: https://ci.internal/artifacts/3425678901/logs

lina: Thanks everyone. Closing change window. Will follow up with a short postmortem if anything crops up.
